description: This file defines the MockHelpers class used for mocking in the absl random internal namespace, facilitating testing of distribution functions by managing mock registration and invocation based on type signatures.

classes.name: MockHelpers
classes.description: A helper class for managing mock functions in the absl random internal namespace, enabling registration and invocation of mocks based on type signatures.

methods.name: MaybeInvokeMock
methods.description: Attempts to invoke a mock function for a given key signature and arguments, returning an optional result.

methods.name: MockFor
methods.description: Registers a mock for a specific key signature with a mock object.
